arxiv-1811-11012.creator: Mohammad A. Hoque, Noah Carter, Md Salman Ahmed, Jacob Hoyos, Matthew Dale, JT Blevins, Nick Hodge, Nusrat Chowdhury, Noah Carter 1 , Md Salman Ahmed 2 Jacob Hoyos 1 , Matthew Dale 1 , JT Blevins 1 , Nick Hodge 1 , Nusrat Chowdhury 1 , Mohammad A. Hoque 1

Hoque, Noah Carter, Md Salman Ahmed, Jacob Hoyos, Matthew Dale, JT Blevins, Nick Hodge, Nusrat Chowdhury, Noah Carter 1 , Md Salman Ahmed 2 Jacob Hoyos 1 , Matthew Dale 1 , JT Blevins 1 , Nick Hodge 1 , Nusrat Chowdhury 1 , Mohammad A. Hoque 1. This technical report is a catalog of two applications that have been enhanced and developed to augment vehicular networking research.

arxiv-2102-02283.title: Measurement of the \PW ​ γ \PW\gamma production cross section in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV and constraints on effective field theory coefficients
arxiv-2102-02283.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by . A fiducial cross section for \PW ​ γ \PW\gamma production in proton-proton collisions is measured at a center-of-mass energy of 13 \TeV in 137 \fbinv of data collected using the CMS detector at the LHC. The \PW → \Pe ​ ν \PW\to\Pe\nu and μ ​ ν \mu\nu decay modes are used in a maximum-likelihood fit to the lepton-photon invariant mass distribution to extract the combined cross section. The measured cross section is compared with theoretical expectations at next-to-leading order in quantum chromodynamics.

arxiv-2103-04583.title: A family of balanced generalized weighing matrices
arxiv-2103-04583.creator: Hadi Kharaghani, Thomas Pender, Sho Suda
arxiv-2103-04583.description: Abstract Balanced weighing matrices with parameters ( 1 + 18 ⋅ 9 m + 1 − 1 8 , 9 m + 1 , 4 ⋅ 9 m ) , \left(1+18\cdot\frac{9^{m+1}-1}{8},9^{m+1},4\cdot 9^{m}\right), for each nonzero integer m m are constructed. This is the first infinite class not belonging to those with classical parameters.

arxiv-2111-11913.title: Polished diamond x-ray lenses
arxiv-2111-11913.creator: Rafael, Sergey, Edgar, Thomas, Raymond
arxiv-2111-11913.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Rafael, Sergey, Edgar, Thomas, Raymond. We present high quality bi-concave 2D focusing diamond x-ray lenses of apex-radius R = 100 µ ​ m R=$100\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro m}$ produced via laser-ablation and improved via a mechanical polishing process.

arxiv-2205-08515.title: Unsupervised Segmentation in Real-World Images via Spelke Object Inference
arxiv-2205-08515.creator: Honglin Chen, Rahul Venkatesh, Yoni Friedman, Jiajun Wu, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Daniel L. K. Yamins, Daniel M. Bear
arxiv-2205-08515.description: Abstract Self-supervised, category-agnostic segmentation of real-world images is a challenging open problem in computer vision. Here, we show how to learn static grouping priors from motion self-supervision by building on the cognitive science concept of a Spelke Object: a set of physical stuff that moves together.

arxiv-2206-03733.title: Number of integers represented by families of binary forms
arxiv-2206-03733.creator: Étienne Fouvry, Michel Waldschmidt
arxiv-2206-03733.description: Abstract We extend our previous results on the number of integers which are values of some cyclotomic form of degree larger than a given value (see [ FW ] ), to more general families of binary forms with integer coefficients.

arxiv-2210-00045.title: Calibrating Sequence likelihood Improves Conditional Language Generation
arxiv-2210-00045.creator: Yao Zhao, Misha Khalman, Rishabh Joshi, Shashi Narayan, Mohammad Saleh, Peter J. Liu, Google Research, Brain Team
arxiv-2210-00045.description: Abstract Conditional language models are predominantly trained with maximum likelihood estimation (MLE), giving probability mass to sparsely observed target sequences. While MLE trained models assign high probability to plausible sequences given the context, the model probabilities often do not accurately rank-order generated sequences by quality.

arxiv-2212-08249.creator: Guilherme Limberg, Anna B. A. Queiroz, Hélio D. Perottoni, Silvia Rossi, João A. S. Amarante, Rafael M. Santucci, Cristina Chiappini, Angeles Pérez-Villegas, Young Sun Lee
arxiv-2212-08249.description: Abstract In this work, we study the phase-space and chemical properties of Sagittarius (Sgr) stream, the tidal tails produced by the ongoing destruction of Sgr dwarf spheroidal (dSph) galaxy, focusing on its very metal-poor (VMP; [ Fe / H ] < − 2 \rm[Fe/H]<-2 ) content.

arxiv-2311-15968.title: Effects of hyperon potentials and symmetry energy in quark deconfinement
arxiv-2311-15968.creator: Rajesh Kumar, Krishna Aryal, Alexander Clevinger, Veronica Dexheimer
arxiv-2311-15968.description: Abstract In this letter we discuss how the results of recent nuclear experiments that correspond to measurements at low densities can affect the equation of state at large densities and temperatures, changing the particle composition and ultimately influencing deconfinement to quark matter.

arxiv-2312-11743.title: On the possibility of engineering social evolution in microfluidic environments
arxiv-2312-11743.creator: Gurdip Uppal, Dervis Can Vural
arxiv-2312-11743.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Gurdip Uppal, Dervis Can Vural. Many species of microbes cooperate by producing public goods from which they collectively benefit. However, these populations are under the risk of being taken over by cheating mutants that do not contribute to the pool of public goods. Here we present theoretical findings that address how the social evolution of microbes can be manipulated by external perturbations, to inhibit or promote the fixation of cheaters.

arxiv-2402-05698.title: Evolving AI for Wellness: Dynamic and Personalized Real-time Loneliness Detection Using Passive Sensing Thanks: This publication has emanated from research conducted with the financial support of Science Foundation Ireland under Grant number 18/CRT/6222
arxiv-2402-05698.creator: Malik Muhammad Qirtas, Evi Zafeiridi, Eleanor Bantry White, Dirk Pesch
arxiv-2402-05698.description: Abstract Loneliness is a growing health concern as it can lead to depression and other associated mental health problems for people who experience feelings of loneliness over prolonged periods of time. Utilizing passive sensing methods that use smartphone and wearable sensor data to capture daily behavioural patterns offers a promising approach for the early detection of loneliness.

arxiv-2406-08312.title: On the nature of the radio calibrator and gamma-ray emitting NLS1 galaxy 3C 286 and its multiwavelength variability
arxiv-2406-08312.creator: S. Komossa*, S. Yao, D. Grupe, A. Kraus
arxiv-2406-08312.description: Abstract The quasar 3C 286, a well-known calibrator source in radio astronomy, was found to exhibit exceptional multiwavelength properties. Its rich and complex optical emission-line spectrum revealed its narrow-line Seyfert 1 (NLS1) nature. Given its strong radio emission, this makes 3C 286 one of the radio-loudest NLS1 galaxies known to date.

arxiv-2509-17783.title: RoboSeek: You Need to Interact with Your Objects
arxiv-2509-17783.creator: Yibo Peng, Jiahao Yang, Shenhao Yan, Ziyu Huang, Shuang Li, Shuguang Cui, Yiming Zhao, Yatong Han FNii-Shenzhen The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen Northeastern University Harbin Engineering University Infused Synapse AI yiming_zhao@hrbeu.edu.cn hanyatong@cuhk.edu.cn
arxiv-2509-17783.description: Abstract Optimizing and refining action execution through exploration and interaction is a promising way for robotic manipulation. However, practical approaches to interaction-driven robotic learning are still underexplored, particularly for long-horizon tasks where sequential decision-making, physical constraints, and perceptual uncertainties pose significant challenges.

arxiv-2510-01841.title: Leveraging Prior Knowledge of Diffusion Model for Person Search
arxiv-2510-01841.creator: Giyeol Kim, Sooyoung Yang, Jihyong Oh, Myungjoo Kang, Chanho Eom, [0.4em] GSAIM, Chung-Ang University
arxiv-2510-01841.description: Abstract Person search aims to jointly perform person detection and re-identification by localizing and identifying a query person within a gallery of uncropped scene images. Existing methods predominantly utilize ImageNet pre-trained backbones, which may be suboptimal for capturing the complex spatial context and fine-grained identity cues necessary for person search.

arxiv-2601-00586.title: Elaboration on the kinetic approach of Derbenev and Kondratenko to spin-polarized beams in electron storage rings
arxiv-2601-00586.creator: K. Heinemann, D.T. Abell, J. Agudelo, D.P. Barber, O. Beznosov, J.P. Devlin, J.A. Ellison, E. Hamwi, B. Nash, M. Vogt
arxiv-2601-00586.description: Abstract We present a detailed account of the kinetic approach for describing the effect of synchrotron radiation on electron and positron spin polarization in storage rings. This approach was introduced in 1974 by Derbenev and Kondratenko and was extended by us since 2001.

pmc-11324763.title: Fault detection and diagnosis of grid-connected photovoltaic systems using energy valley optimizer based lightweight CNN and wavelet transform
pmc-11324763.creator: Ali Teta, Belkacem Korich, Derradji Bakria, Nadji Hadroug, Abdelaziz Rabehi, Mohammad Alsharef, Mohit Bajaj, Ievgen Zaitsev, Sherif S. M. Ghoneim
pmc-11324763.description: Early fault detection and diagnosis of grid-connected photovoltaic systems (GCPS) is imperative to improve their performance and reliability. Low-cost edge devices have emerged as innovative solutions for real-time monitoring, reducing latency, and improving response times. In this work, a lightweight Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is designed and fine-tuned using Energy Valley Optimizer (EVO) for fault diagnosis.

pmc-11385490.title: Associations between smartphone addiction, parenting styles, and mental well-being among adolescents aged 15–19 years in Gujarat, India
pmc-11385490.creator: M Yogesh, Hemangi Ladani, Dipesh Parmar
pmc-11385490.description: BackgroundThe pervasive use of smartphones among adolescents has raised concerns about addiction and its impact on mental well-being. This study investigates the prevalence of smartphone addiction and its associations with socio-demographic factors, parenting styles, and mental health among Indian adolescents.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted among 560 school-going adolescents (aged 15–19) in Gujarat, India, from January to October 2023.

pmc-12560476.title: Analysis of the correlation between abdominal pain and long Meckel’s diverticulitis on the mesenteric side: a case study in the context of mesenteric volvulus and internal hernias: a case report
pmc-12560476.creator: Junjun Sun, Yong Liang
pmc-12560476.description: BackgroundMeckel’s diverticulum is a common congenital gastrointestinal malformation that affects approximately 2% of the population. While the majority of individuals with this condition remain asymptomatic, complications such as intestinal obstruction, hemorrhage, and inflammation can occur, leading to significant clinical implications.

pmc-12637402.title: Discovery of a PDE4B and PDE4D selective bifunctional degrader for management of chronic inflammatory disorders
pmc-12637402.creator: Arvind Shakya, Qiao Liu, Chon Lai, Sherry Baker, Steven Greene, Paul Erdman, Athri Rathnayake, Angela Schoolmeesters, Connor M Blair, Elka Kyurkchieva, Navin Rajapakse, Imelda Lam, Yuan Yan Sin, George S Baillie, Shenlin Huang, Aparajita H Chourasia, Leah Fung
pmc-12637402.description: Atopic dermatitis (AD) is a chronic inflammatory skin disorder characterized by redness and itching, impacting over 15 million individuals in the US. The pathogenesis of AD involves T helper 2 (TH2) and 17 (TH17) cytokines, which contribute to increased inflammation, a compromised skin barrier, and heightened susceptibility to infections and allergen sensitization.

pmc-12643632.title: Proton pump inhibitors and the risk of urolithiasis: A Mendelian randomization study
pmc-12643632.creator: Jiawei Guo, Xinyu Chen, Yongqi Dou, Yongjiang Xiong, Tao Zhao
pmc-12643632.description: Observational studies suggest that proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) increase the risk of urolithiasis (UL). However, the causal correlation between the 2 is still unclear. To examine the causal relationship between PPIs and UL, this study used 2-sample Mendelian randomization. The genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of Omeprazole, Esomeprazole, Lansoprazole, and Rabeprazole medication can be obtained from GWAS catalog.

pmc-13017999.title: Mortality and its predictors among neurosurgical patients admitted to the surgical ICU in a resource-limited setting: experience from Ethiopia
pmc-13017999.creator: Absera Gebriel Yohannes, Molla Asnake Kebede, Amira Shamil, Kidus Geabriel Yohannes, Dejen Tekiea Gebrewahd, Turi Abateka Abadiga, Abera Kuma, Selemon Gebrezgabiher Asgedom
pmc-13017999.description: BackgroundNeurosurgical patients frequently require intensive postoperative care. However, data on the factors influencing their outcomes in low-resource environments are limited. This study aimed to identify the predictors of mortality among neurosurgical patients admitted to the Surgical Intensive Care Unit at the Tikur Anbessa Specialized Hospital, Ethiopia.MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted between January 1, 2024, and January 1, 2025.

pmc-13061806.title: An autoantibody signature predictive for multiple sclerosis: evidence at the protein level and association with histopathological lesion types
pmc-13061806.creator: S. Jarius, K. Ruprecht, I. Metz, F. B. König, J. Haas, W. Brück, F. Paul, B. Wildemann
pmc-13061806.description: Recently, an autoantibody signature considered to be predictive of multiple sclerosis (MS) has been reported in an article by Zamecnik et al. published in Nature Medicine, which is characterized by immunoglobulin G (IgG) responses to peptides sharing the amino acid motif P-(SA)-x-(SGA)-R-(SN)-(LRKH).
